request: When is the Highway Trust Fund projected to run short of money?

reply.reply:
CRS’s latest cited CBO projection says the Highway Trust Fund’s **Highway Account** balance will approach zero in **FY2028**, assuming current revenue and spending trends continue. The separate **Mass Transit Account** is projected to approach zero in FY2027. (CRS R48948, PDF p. 7)

These are projections of balances approaching zero, not evidence that either account has already run out. See the [brief](output/briefs/case-20261025-145714-3ef9.html).
reply.reasoning: The newest verified CRS finding directly gives the account-specific dates and the assumption behind the projection.
